card.name: Start of Danyelza and Dal- drug names
card.fires_on: The piece right after the first letter or syllable of a brand or generic drug name, mainly 'ANY' in D-ANY-ELZA and 'Dal' in Dalmane or dalbavancin. It appears in prescribing-information text.

modes.label: DANYELZA
modes.description: The 'ANY' piece after 'D' in the brand name DANYELZA.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue D<<ANY>>ELZA based on severity

modes.label: Dal- names
modes.description: The 'Dal' or 'dal' piece starting Dalmane or dalbavancin.
modes.example: Table 1. Dosage of<< Dal>>bavancin for Injection in Pediatric

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the rest of the drug name, such as ELZA or bavancin, rather than ordinary words.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening piece of certain drug names like Danyelza and dalbavancin.
